title: H 3180 (119th General Assembly): Voting

(other) SECTION 1 also changes 'any person' to 'a person' and 'any ballot' to 'a ballot' (wording only).
(other) SECTION 2: takes effect upon approval by the Governor.
(other) version: 2010-12-07_Introduced (only version): adds a photo college identification card to the ID list in slot a. No slot b, c or d text.
(other) note: Same college-ID text as H 3078 of 2009, filed before Act 27 of 2011 (it reprints the 1996 form of 7-13-710, 'Department of Public Safety', 'if he is not licensed to drive'). One version, introduced only; no floor action found in the saved record.
